email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with occasional dizziness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 53-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their second dose of DemoZanix (dose: 50mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-07-28.
Approximately 8 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
L. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter746@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
